# `org.member.remove`

Remove an organization member

Session-only, organization owners. Removes the user from every team. Refuses the last owner.

- Method and path: `POST /{org}/-/members/{user}/remove`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie org member remove`
- MCP: `org_member_remove`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `org` | path | yes | `string` |
| `user` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `not-found`, `unauthorized`, plus the framework problems.
